# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIVERGENCE_BOS_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bearish RSI divergence (price makes a higher high while RSI(14) makes a lower low) coupled with a break of structure (BOS) to the downside signals a short opportunity. This edge exists because it combines momentum exhaustion (divergence) with a structural shift (BOS), increasing the probability of a continued down move.

## Mechanism

Entry rule:  
- Identify bearish RSI divergence: price makes a higher high (HH) while RSI(14) makes a lower low on the same bar.  
- On the same bar or the next bar, a market structure break (BOS) to the downside occurs (price breaks below the most recent swing low).  
- Enter short at the close of the bar that shows the BOS.  

Exit shape:  
- Chart-stop at the recent swing high (the prior HH that formed the divergence).  
- TP1 at 1.0R (risk-reward of 1:1).  
- Runner trails 20% off the high-water mark (HWM) after TP1 is hit.  

Regime hint: Works in choppy/low-trend regimes (VIX 15-25) and after the first hour to avoid opening-range noise.
